footnote_text: Upon termination of the Robert Leeds 2024 GRAT on November 24, 2026, the Robert Leeds 2024 GRAT distributed all 603,909 shares of common stock it held. Of those shares, 376,902 were distributed to the Robert Leeds Declaration of Trust and continue to be reported as indirectly owned by the reporting person. The remaining 227,007 shares were distributed to the Robert Leeds 2008 Family Trust.

Upon termination of the Bruce Leeds 2024 GRAT on November 24, 2026, the Bruce Leeds 2024 GRAT distributed 515,923 shares of common stock to the Bruce Leeds 2008 Family Trust. The reporting person serves as a co-trustee and disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.

Upon termination of the Richard Leeds 2024 GRAT on November 24, 2026, the Richard Leeds 2024 GRAT distributed 330,192 shares of common stock to the Richard Leeds 2008 Family Trust. The reporting person serves as a co-trustee and disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.
